thread:
Eva CSM: Just off a call with Northbridge onboarding — quick dump of product feedback and asks.
Eva CSM: TL;DR: 3 product issues causing friction during onboarding + a feature request for in-console analytics. Recording: https://zoom.us/rec/share/nb-onboard-9142
redwood-bot: Recording uploaded to Drive: https://drive.company/northbridge-call (access: company)
Sahil AE: How many customers are hit by each issue? renewal risk?
Eva CSM: Quick counts: Northbridge (pilot, high touch) + 2 other pilots + ~5 early adopters in sandbox. Northbridge said "we'll pause rollout" unless session resume is fixed — renewal risk medium-high.
Alex Support: We already have 5 Zendesk tickets matching the "resume -> new convo" behavior last week. Logs attached to ticket #5231.
Eva CSM: Notes from call (paste):
```
- session_resume_mismatch: when user backgrounded tab for >2m the resumed session gets new convo id; KV cache mismatch causes context loss. Customer quote: "It felt like the assistant forgot everything."
- export_prompt_analytics: customers want per-prompt CSV with tokens, latency, and a simple quality score (manual rating or eval hook).
- rollout_toggle_ui: no easy in-console canary toggle; enterprise teams resort to API scripts to flip models per route.
- embeddings_drift_obs: after small model update, similarity scores changed; customers want versioned embedding snapshots.
```
Jon PM: Thanks. Can you open GH issues (or product board cards) with repro steps + attach support logs & recording? For triage I'd tentatively assign: session_resume = P0 (blocking onboarding), export_prompt_analytics = P1, rollout_toggle_ui = P2, embeddings_drift = P2. Agree/disagree?
Maya ProdOps: Add labels: onboarding-bug, renewal-risk, analytics-request. I'll put them into the weekly triage queue and flag for design review.
Sahil AE: If P0 isn't acknowledged with an ETA by mid-month I'll escalate on the renewal call.
Eva CSM: Creating tickets now — will include repro steps, stack traces, example payloads, and a short customer quote. Posting links in thread when done.
Alex Support: If Eng wants, I can attach full request/response logs and the minimal repro script we used.
Jon PM: Good — once tickets are up ping me. I'll carve out a quick spike for session_resume with Eng. If spike validates root cause we can slot the fix in next sprint.
redwood-bot: New issues created: PROD-1182 (session_resume), PROD-1183 (prompt_export), PROD-1184 (rollout-toggle-ui) — links added to this thread.
Eva CSM: Links posted, added Northbridge as reporter on PROD-1182.
Maya ProdOps: I'll coordinate a short design session for the export UI; aim for mock by Fri.
Jon PM: Great. Action owners: Eva -> file tickets & attach artifacts; Alex -> support logs; Maya -> design mock; Jon -> schedule spike. Check back here after tickets are updated. :thumbsup:
Eva CSM: Done — tickets + artifacts attached. Thanks everyone. :heart:
